title: The Death and Resurrection of Lazarus

questions.question: Who was the sister of Lazarus who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped His feet with her hair?
questions.explanation: John 11:2 (ESV): "It was Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was ill."

questions.question: When Jesus heard that Lazarus was ill, He said, "This illness does not lead to death. It is for..."?
options: "...the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
"...to show the faith of the disciples safely."
questions.correctAnswer: "...the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
questions.explanation: John 11:4 (ESV): "But when Jesus heard it he said, 'This illness does not lead to death. It is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.'"

questions.question: How many days did Jesus stay in the place where He was after hearing Lazarus was ill?
questions.explanation: John 11:6 (ESV): "So, when he heard that Lazarus was ill, he stayed two days longer in the place where he was."

questions.question: When Jesus told the disciples "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I go to awaken him," what did the disciples initially think He meant?
options: They thought that he meant Lazarus was taking rest in sleep
They believed he securely meant death
They assumed safely he fell into a trance
questions.correctAnswer: They thought that he meant Lazarus was taking rest in sleep
questions.explanation: John 11:13 (ESV): "Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he meant taking rest in sleep."

questions.question: Which disciple, called the Twin, bravely said to his fellow disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him"?
questions.explanation: John 11:16 (ESV): "So Thomas, called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, 'Let us also go, that we may die with him.'"

questions.question: When Jesus arrived at Bethany, how long had Lazarus already been in the tomb?
questions.explanation: John 11:17 (ESV): "Now when Jesus came, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days."

questions.question: What bold statement of faith did Martha make to Jesus even after her brother had died?
options: "But even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you."
"I know entirely that he rests safely in heaven."
"If you pray purely, he might wake securely."
questions.correctAnswer: "But even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you."
questions.explanation: John 11:22 (ESV): "But even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you."

questions.question: Jesus said to Martha, "I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he..."?
questions.explanation: John 11:25 (ESV): "Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live,'"

questions.question: When Martha professed her faith to Jesus, what did she call Him?
options: "the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world."
"the Prophet solely predicted in the Law."
"the Healer entirely sent safely from above."
"the good Shepherd securely watching the flock."
questions.correctAnswer: "the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world."
questions.explanation: John 11:27 (ESV): "She said to him, 'Yes, Lord; I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world.'"

questions.question: What is the shortest verse in the English Bible found in John 11, describing Jesus' reaction to the weeping?
When Jesus commanded the stone be taken away from the tomb, why did Martha object?
options: "Lord, by this time there will be an odor, for he has been dead four days."
"We have securely anointing purely to do still."
"It is fiercely unlawful to open completely a tomb."
questions.correctAnswer: "Lord, by this time there will be an odor, for he has been dead four days."
questions.explanation: John 11:39 (ESV): "Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, 'Lord, by this time there will be an odor, for he has been dead four days.'"

questions.question: Before raising Lazarus, Jesus prayed ALOUD, "Father, I thank you that you have heard me." Why did He say this aloud?
options: "on account of the people standing around, that they may believe that you sent me."
"to legally fulfill safely the law completely."
"because the stone securely muffled entirely his voice."
"so the angels completely would hear purely."
questions.correctAnswer: "on account of the people standing around, that they may believe that you sent me."
questions.explanation: John 11:42 (ESV): "I knew that you always hear me, but I said this on account of the people standing around, that they may believe that you sent me."

questions.question: What loud cry did Jesus make to call Lazarus from the tomb?
questions.explanation: John 11:43 (ESV): "When he had said these things, he cried out with a loud voice, 'Lazarus, come out.'"

questions.question: After the resurrection of Lazarus, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered the council worried that if Jesus kept doing signs, the Romans would come and destroy what?
questions.explanation: John 11:48 (ESV): "If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."

questions.question: Who was the high priest that year who unknowingly prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation?
questions.explanation: John 11:49-51 (ESV): "But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said... he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,"

key_verse_text: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live,"
